02 / FEATURES

Client
features

Input settings, statistics,
HUD options and integrations.

01Input & smoothing

Fast Input uses reduced visual delay with TClient interpolation. Smart Smooth supports a manually configured ping and separate profiles with and without AntiPing.

02KoG, Map Tries & History

KoG shows player points, ranking and completed maps. Map Tries tracks attempts per map. History records visits, online time and server statistics.

03Finish cards

Save the map, completion time, freezes, saves and lasts when you finish a map.

04HUD & interface

Minimap, full-map view, server browser and friends list, plus Twitch messages in the game chat.

FINISH CARDS✦

Map completion time
and session statistics.
